paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on GLM-4-9B-Instruct on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the accuracy achieved by various prompting strategies over a range of sampling times, comparing their performance on the MATH benchmark using GLM-4-9B-Instruct. The horizontal axis represents sampling time, marked in units of steps from 0 to 70, with evenly spaced integer labels. The vertical axis represents accuracy, measured in percentage points, ranging from 45 to 85, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 5. The graph contains seven distinct lines, each corresponding to a different prompting strategy as identified in the legend.

The purple line, labeled "DiP", begins at an accuracy of approximately 45% at sampling time 0 and increases to around 57% by sampling time 70. The orange line, labeled "AnP", starts near 45% at time 0 and rises to approximately 58% at time 70. The blue line, labeled "CoT", begins at around 45% at time 0 and steadily increases to approximately 64% at time 70. The cyan line, labeled "L2M", starts at around 45% at time 0 and rises to approximately 62% at time 70. The light orange line, labeled "SBP", begins near 45% at time 0 and increases to approximately 61% at time 70. The dashed black line, labeled "Dynamic w/ Oracle", starts at approximately 70% at time 0 and remains relatively stable, fluctuating slightly between approximately 70% and 73% up to time 70. The red dotted line, labeled "Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle", begins at approximately 70% at time 0 and remains nearly constant at approximately 83% for the entire duration from time 0 to time 70.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the accuracy of six different prompting strategies—DiP, AnP, CoT, Dynamic w/ Oracle, L2M, and Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle—as a function of sampling time on the MATH benchmark using GLM-4-9B-Instruct. The x-axis, labeled “Sampling Time,” ranges from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10, representing the number of samples used in the test-time scaling process. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 45 to 85 and is scaled linearly, representing the percentage of correctly solved problems. The DiP strategy is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 46.5 accuracy at sampling time 0 and rising to about 60.5 at sampling time 70. The AnP strategy is shown as an orange line with triangle markers, beginning at around 46.5 and increasing to approximately 59.5. The CoT strategy is depicted by a blue line with triangle markers, starting at about 49.5 and reaching roughly 63.5. The Dynamic w/ Oracle strategy is shown as a black dashed line with square markers, beginning at approximately 71.5 and remaining relatively flat at around 71.5 to 73.5. The L2M strategy is represented by a cyan line with triangle markers, starting at about 48.5 and rising to approximately 62.5. The SBP strategy is shown as a light orange line with triangle markers, beginning at around 48.5 and increasing to approximately 61.5. The Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle strategy is represented by a red dotted line with circular markers, starting at approximately 71.5 and remaining nearly constant at around 83.5 throughout the sampling time range.
